items.description: The tidal River Yare from Thorpe St Andrew to Breydon Water
items.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding.
The previous tide of concern has now passed,  the weather is more settled and no flooding is expected.  
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.  
Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger.

items.description: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
items.message: High water levels today, Friday 13 November may lead to flooding.  Flooding is possible throughout today, Friday 13 November.  We expect to see high water levels around Potter Heigham, Wroxham boat yards and Ferry Road in Horning. Levels can take several hours to peak. We are not expecting the situation to escalate, or to issue any further warning messages at this time. We are closely monitoring the situation. Avoid coastal roads and low lying roads near rivers, which may be flooded. This message will be updated by 10am Saturday 14 November, or as the situation changes.
